title: RE60001: Reliability Analysis And Prediction
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Definition. Causes and types of failures. Reliability expressions for constant,
increasing and decreasing hazard rates. Data Analysis, Probability plots for
various distributions (exponential, Weibull, Normal and Gamma). Series,
parallel, series-parallel, standby and k-out-of-m modeling. System reliability
evaluation techniques, including methods of bounds, decomposition and
transformation techniques. Single and Multiple variable inversion techniques
for minimizing system reliability expression. Analysis of dependent failures.
Reliability computations using similar and dissimilar stress-strength
distributions (exponential, Weibull, normal and Gamma). Time dependent stressstrength distributions, fatigue failures, Recent trends in reliability
evaluation techniques.
